prompt.zh-CN: 为 `top_spenders` 写测试。你的测试必须先在参考实现上全绿，然后尽量杀死预埋的错误实现。
prompt.en-US: Write tests for `top_spenders`. They must pass on the reference implementation first, then kill as many planted wrong implementations as they can.

spec.zh-CN: `top_spenders(transfers, accounts, n)`：`transfers` 是 `(source, target, amount)`。返回前 `n` 个账户，格式 `"id(累计转出)"`；按累计转出降序，并列按 id 升序；没转出过的账户算 0，也参与排行。
spec.en-US: `top_spenders(transfers, accounts, n)`: `transfers` are `(source, target, amount)`. Returns the first `n` accounts as `"id(total outgoing)"`, by total descending, ties by id ascending; accounts with no outgoing transfer count as 0 and still rank.

explanation.zh-CN: 四个变异体各对应一句规格：并列方向、恰好 `n` 个、同一账户多笔求和、零支出账户也要出现。每句规格至少要有一条测试把它钉死。
explanation.en-US: Each of the four mutants breaks one clause of the spec: tie direction, exactly `n` results, summing repeated transfers, and zero-spend accounts still ranking. Every clause needs at least one test that pins it.

hints.zh-CN: 规格里有几个“并且”？每个都写一条测试。
hints.en-US: How many clauses does the spec have? Write one test per clause.

hints.zh-CN: 让两个账户支出相同，看谁排前面。
hints.en-US: Give two accounts the same total and check who comes first.

description.zh-CN: 并列时按 id 降序
用最后一笔金额覆盖而不是累加
description.en-US: Keeps the last amount instead of summing

description.zh-CN: 没转出过的账户不出现
description.en-US: Leaves out accounts that never sent money
